outcome.technical: tests/test_drive_phase.py only (the worktree's git diff --stat shows 151 insertions and 9 deletions). (1) _WRITER_STUB: WS_LOG may name a directory, in which case each stub session creates a file of its own with tempfile.mkstemp (O_EXCL) and writes its one line there. A file still gets the same append as before. (2) _stub_runs(where) now reads a file, a list of files, or a directory in file-name order, using the new _stub_run_lines. Its docstring carries the table: each log a stub or child appends to (WS_LOG as a file, WS_LOG as a directory, _AUTO_CHILD marks pointing to _auto_marks' own table, _RB_LOG, LP_PROBE_LOG/LP_PROBE_TOUCH, DRIVE_CWD_LOG, owner.log), the cases that use it, and whether they run at once or one after another. Each row is read off what starts the processes: _play_session/subprocess.run, run-test-gate's per-step communicate, run_lint_probe, claimed_followers, and auto_run, which starts a step's commands together and so starts more than one only for a wave. It also names what is left: the driver's own auto log, opened once in append mode and shared by a wave's children, which no case reads from a wave (bq5 reads it from a single child), and WS_PIDS, which is written whole, not appended. (3) au32 now hands its stub a directory. New au32c: two files of one run each, the same count as au32, with a matching skip on hosts without killpg. au32's expectation is unchanged (len(runs) == 2). (4) tm2 now picks the writer's wait with the new _tm_session_waits(waits, record), which reads the basis naming the writer's own session record (the basename of its --record flag, anchored to end or ';'). The arithmetic becomes the assertion through _tm_ends_at. New tm2b uses the driver's real session_stages to build a writer wait 10->12 and a reviewer wait handed out and started at 12 (0 ms). It asserts that arithmetic picks 2, the basis picks exactly the writer's 2000 ms wait, and the reviewer's wait is picked by its own record. Every other place in the suite that picks a stage was checked: tm6 already picks by basis ('evidence row <runId>'), and tm8 picks by kind and count with arithmetic only as an assertion. So tm2 was the only case that picked a stage by arithmetic. Commands: the gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` was run twice, minutes apart; both exit 0 with '1/1 files ok, 1020 cases'. Blocks au32-block plus tm-block: 18/18 on this tree against 16/16 for HEAD's copy (git show HEAD:tests/test_drive_phase.py run from scratch), so the count went up by au32c and tm2b and nothing dropped. ruff check: exit 0. vermin -t=3.8-: exit 0. prose_number_claims and house_style_violations: no hits for this file. Dependants: tests/test_drive_without_model.py imports _stub_runs/_writer_stub/_base_measure_repo and passes a file path, whose behaviour is unchanged; `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_without_model.py` exit 0, 74 cases. .github/sweep-costs.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml, tools/affected.py, plugins/audit/scripts/governance/drive-phase.py, tests/test__runner_output.py, tests/test_run_test_gate.py and tests/test_stamp_verification.py refer to this file by path or import other names (_actions). No block was added or renamed and no imported name changed, so they are still correct. Every case that reads the writer-stub log keeps its expected values: the file path is unchanged for all of them except au32, whose count expectation stays 2.
outcome.descriptive: No two stub sessions in the drive suite append to one log at once, the suite says which logs are shared and why that is safe, and the writer's wait is picked by its own session record, so the reviewer's wait in the same second can no longer be picked too.
